steps.name: count
steps.expr: const qs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.qz')]; return qs.length+' questions · types '+JSON.stringify(qs.reduce((a,q)=>(a[q.dataset.type]=(a[q.dataset.type]||0)+1,a),{}))+' · figs '+[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-fig]')].map(f=>f.dataset.fig+':'+(f.querySelector('svg,table')?'ok':'EMPTY')).join(',')+' · progress: '+document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent

steps.name: matrix click
steps.expr: const ths=[...document.querySelectorAll('.lec-matrix thead th')].map(t=>t.textContent); const j=ths.indexOf('rise')-1; document.querySelector('td.cell[data-i="0"][data-j="'+j+'"]').click(); const t=document.getElementById('lec-trace').textContent; return t.slice(0,160)

steps.name: pick single
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-newdoc"]'); h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button')[0].click(); return h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent+' | right marked: '+h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button.right').length+' wrong: '+h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button.wrong').length

steps.name: point multi via figure
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-sg-where"]'); h.querySelector('[data-pick="win"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); const picked=1; return 'picked '+picked+' | '+h.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent+' | svg classes: '+[...h.querySelectorAll('[data-pick]')].map(g=>g.dataset.pick+'='+g.getAttribute('class')).join(' ')

steps.name: agg explorer
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.agg').parentNode; const rows=[...h.querySelectorAll('.agg-table tr[data-a]')].map(r=>r.dataset.a+':'+[...r.querySelectorAll('td')].slice(1).map(td=>td.textContent).join(' ')); h.querySelector('tr[data-a="concat"]').click(); const flat=!!h.querySelector('.agg-flat'); h.querySelector('tr[data-a="sum"]').click(); h.querySelector('button[data-t="3"]').click(); return rows.join(' | ')+' || concat flat: '+flat+' || '+h.querySelector('.agg-out').textContent

steps.name: point cbow + ft
steps.expr: const c=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-cbow-target"]'); c.querySelector('[data-pick="out"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); const f=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-ft-learned"]'); f.querySelector('[data-pick="vec"]').dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); return 'cbow: '+c.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent+' | ft: '+f.querySelector('.qz-verdict').textContent

steps.name: write
steps.expr: const h=document.querySelector('.qz[data-q="q-design"]'); h.querySelector('textarea').value='tf-idf + logreg'; h.querySelector('textarea').dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click(); return 'ticks: '+h.querySelectorAll('.qz-ticks input').length+' | answer: '+h.querySelector('.qz-a').textContent.slice(0,60)

steps.name: progress + persistence
steps.expr: const p=document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent; const st=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('quiz:week01_lecture')); return p+' | stored keys: '+Object.keys(st).filter(k=>st[k].done).join(',')

steps.name: answer all
steps.expr: document.querySelectorAll('.qz').forEach(h=>{ if(h.classList.contains('done')) return; const t=h.dataset.type; if(t==='pick'||t==='point'){h.querySelectorAll('.qz-opts button')[0].click(); const c=h.querySelector('.qz-check'); if(c){c.click();}} else if(t==='sort'){h.querySelectorAll('table.qz-sort tr').forEach(tr=>tr.querySelector('button').click()); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else if(t==='fill'){h.querySelectorAll('input.qz-blank').forEach(i=>{i.value='x'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));}); h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} else {h.querySelector('.qz-check').click();} }); return document.getElementById('quiz-progress').textContent

steps.name: svg-text
steps.expr: const bad=[]; document.querySelectorAll('svg').forEach((s,si)=>{const sb=s.getBoundingClientRect(); const ts=[...s.querySelectorAll('text')]; ts.forEach((t,i)=>{const b=t.getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<sb.left-1||b.right>sb.right+1||b.top<sb.top-1||b.bottom>sb.bottom+1) bad.push('clip svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,30)); for(let j=i+1;j<ts.length;j++){const c=ts[j].getBoundingClientRect(); if(b.left<c.right-1&&c.left<b.right-1&&b.top<c.bottom-1&&c.top<b.bottom-1) bad.push('overlap svg'+si+': '+t.textContent.slice(0,20)+' / '+ts[j].textContent.slice(0,20));}});}); return bad.length? bad.join(' || ') : 'svg text clean ('+document.querySelectorAll('svg text').length+' labels)'
